content.title: A university unlike any other.
content.text: Explore our programs 200+ degrees and certificates to choose from.Your future is unlimited. View all A TOP 50 public research university National Science Foundation Rams say it best What makes VCU a place unlike any other? The people. The opportunities. And so much more. We are the UNCOMMON Profiles in excellence Kaity Myers ’25 After dance helped her find her voice, this MBA graduate (who also majored in dance and choreography at VCU) plans to put her creative vision to use in the business world. More about Kaity Kyler Gilliam ’25 This double major in broadcast journalism and media production made time to serve as director of the VCUInsight broadcast program, president of a student org and a writer for the student newspaper. More about Kyler Sarah Hagen ’25 As managing editor for the student newspaper and reporter for the Capital News Service, this mass communications major also cheered on the Rams as a trombonist for the Peppas. More about Sarah Rawan Elbanna ’25 After graduating at age 20 with a double major in criminal justice and homeland security and preparedness, she’s setting her sights on a master’s degree and, eventually, law school. More about Rawan Nihal Patel This second-year medical student uses the library’s makerspace to create free, custom 3D-printed assistive devices for individuals with disabilities. More about Nihal Liam Babcock In his senior year, this biology major is working in two research labs on the MCV Campus while juggling coursework and a thesis project exploring ways to improve prostate cancer treatment.
